preview: Jamaica Kingsmen face St Kitts & Nevis Patriots in CPL 2026 Match 10 at Sabina Park. The match is scheduled for Tue 18 Aug at 7pm local time.
preview_detail: The CPL's newest franchise restores a Jamaica-based men's team, led by a local group featuring Rovman Powell, Andre Russell and Odean Smith. The Patriots unite CPL's leading career run-scorer Johnson Charles with Andre Fletcher, while Jason Holder returns to strengthen an experienced Caribbean group. The final playing XIs will be confirmed after the toss.
